fields.description_en: In the past month, on how many days did you drink 6 or more drinks on one occasion? [Note: 6 drinks = 4.5 cans of beer (330 c.c. each); 6.5 cans of fruit beer (330 c.c. each); 8 small bottles of ice-fire sparkling wine (275 c.c. each); 6.5 cups of Vita Bee or Paolyta B (120 c.c. each); 5 glasses of red wine (120 c.c. each); 0.7 bottle of Shaoxing wine (600 c.c.); 1 small bottle of ginseng-antler wine (300 c.c.); 4 small cups of whiskey, sorghum liquor, or other spirits (45 c.c. each)]

fields.description_zh: 您最近一次喝醉酒是什麼時候?
fields.value_labels: 0:從來都沒有喝醉, 1:最近七天, 2:超過一星期至一個月內, 3:超過一個月至半年內, 4:超過半年至一年內, 5:超過一年以上
fields.description_en: When was the last time you got drunk?

fields.description_zh: 過去一個月，有幾天您喝醉酒?
fields.description_en: In the past month, how many days were you drunk?

fields.description_zh: 對您來說，拿到酒類飲料是一件容易的事嗎?
fields.value_labels: 1:非常困難, 2:有點難, 3:容易, 4:非常容易
fields.description_en: For you, is it easy to obtain alcoholic beverages?

fields.description_zh: 在過去十二個月，您曾經有自己去買過酒嗎（包括各種酒類、保力達B、維士比與藥酒，與煮菜時加進去的酒，所有的酒都算）？
fields.description_en: In the past 12 months, have you personally bought alcohol (including all types of alcohol, Paolyta B, Vita Bee, medicinal liquor, and cooking wine - all types of alcohol count)?

fields.description_zh: 過去十二個月期間您自己去買酒時，是否有人檢查您的身分證明(如身分證或健保卡)？
fields.description_en: During the past twelve months, when you went to buy alcohol yourself, did anyone check your identification (such as your ID card or National Health Insurance card)?

fields.description_zh: 從以前到現在為止，請問您是否曾吸紙菸，俗稱的香菸或捲菸？【若有】總共有超過五包（約100支）嗎？
fields.value_labels: 0:從未吸過紙菸, 1:曾吸紙菸，但未超過5包, 2:曾吸紙菸，而且超過5包
fields.description_en: From the past until now, have you ever smoked paper cigarettes, commonly known as cigarettes or roll-ups? [If yes] Have you smoked more than five packs (about 100 cigarettes) in total?

fields.description_zh: 問您現在是每天吸菸、有時候吸菸還是都不吸菸呢？
fields.description_en: Ask whether he/she currently smokes every day, sometimes, or not at all?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一個月內（30天內），請問您大約有幾天吸菸呢？
fields.description_en: In the past month (30 days), on approximately how many days did you smoke?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一個月內（30天內），平均一天吸幾根菸？（一包菸20支）
fields.description_en: In the past month (30 days), on average how many cigarettes did you smoke per day? (One pack = 20 cigarettes)

fields.description_zh: 在過去一個月內（30天內），請問您有吸菸的日子中，平均一天吸幾根菸？（一包菸20支）
fields.description_en: In the past month (30 days), on days when you smoked, on average how many cigarettes did you smoke per day? (One pack = 20 cigarettes)

fields.description_zh: 請問您幾歲開始有吸菸的習慣？【會主動想吸菸】【以前有吸菸習慣的人也要問】
fields.description_en: At what age did you start smoking as a habit? [Actively wanting to smoke] [Also ask people who used to smoke]

fields.description_zh: 請問您幾足歲開始有吸菸的習慣？
fields.description_en: At what age (in full years) did you start smoking as a habit?

fields.description_zh: 【若個案主動提到戒菸已1年以上，可直接勾選2，其餘問:】在過去十二個月（一年）內，請問您有沒有因為想戒菸而停止吸菸一天或一天以上？
fields.description_en: 【If the case spontaneously mentions having quit smoking for more than 1 year, you may directly select 2; otherwise ask:】 In the past twelve months (one year), have you stopped smoking for one day or more because you wanted to quit?

fields.description_zh: 在未來這一年內，請問以下哪一個說法最能符合您對戒菸的想法？
fields.value_labels: 1:打算在1個月內戒菸, 2:打算在1年內戒菸, 3:未來1年內不打算戒菸
fields.description_en: In the coming year, which of the following statements best matches your thoughts on quitting smoking?

fields.description_en: What is your past usage status of pipe smoking?

fields.description_zh: 請問您目前吸食菸斗狀況？
fields.description_en: What is your current status of smoking a pipe?

fields.description_zh: 平均每天吸食菸斗數量？

fields.description_en: What is your current status of smoking cigars or cigarillos?

fields.description_zh: 平均每天吸食雪茄、小雪茄數量？
fields.description_en: Average daily quantity of cigars/cigarillos used?

fields.description_en: What is your past usage status of hookah (water pipe tobacco)?

fields.description_zh: 平均每天吸食水菸數量？
fields.description_en: Average daily quantity of water pipe (shisha/hookah) used?

fields.value_labels: 0:從未使用, 1:曾經每天使用, 2:曾經使用， 但不是每天

fields.description_zh: 請問您目前吸食無煙菸草製品(例如：鼻菸、嚼菸、口含菸)狀況？
fields.description_en: What is your current status of using smokeless tobacco products (e.g., snuff, chewing tobacco, oral tobacco)?

fields.description_zh: 平均每天吸食無煙菸草製品(例如：鼻菸、嚼菸、口含菸)數量？
fields.description_en: Average daily quantity of smokeless tobacco products (e.g., snuff, chewing tobacco, oral tobacco) used?

fields.description_zh: 請問您過去吸食電子煙狀況？
fields.value_labels: 0:從未使用, 1:曾經每天使用, 2:曾經使用， 但不是每天
fields.description_en: What is your past usage status of e-cigarettes?

fields.description_en: What is your current status of using e-cigarettes?

fields.description_zh: 平均每天吸食電子煙數量？
fields.description_en: Average daily quantity of e-cigarettes used?

fields.description_en: What is your past usage status of heated tobacco products (iQOS)?

fields.description_zh: 請問您目前吸食加熱式菸品(iQOS)狀況？

fields.description_zh: 平均每天吸食加熱式菸品(iQOS)數量？
fields.description_en: Average daily quantity of heated tobacco products (iQOS) used?

fields.value_labels: 0:從未使用, 1:曾經每天使用, 2:曾經使用， 但不是每天

fields.description_en: Do you do vigorous sports, fitness, or recreational physical activities that noticeably increase your breathing and heart rate, such as playing basketball (soccer, tennis, running), for at least 10 minutes at a time?

fields.description_zh: 請問，您每週通常有多少天進行10分鐘以上的劇烈的運動、健身和休閒性身體活動？
fields.description_en: How many days per week do you usually do vigorous sports, fitness, or recreational physical activities for 10 minutes or more?

fields.description_zh: 請問，有做這些活動的日子，您每天通常花多長時間做這些劇烈的活動？___小時___分鐘 ? 小時
fields.description_en: On days when you do these activities, how much time do you usually spend on these vigorous activities each day? ___ hours ___ minutes ? Hours

fields.description_zh: 請問，有做這些活動的日子，您每天通常花多長時間做這些劇烈的活動？___小時___分鐘 ? 分鐘
fields.description_en: On days when you do these activities, how much time do you usually spend on these vigorous activities each day? ___ hours ___ minutes ? Minutes

fields.description_zh: 請問，您會做讓呼吸和心跳輕度增加的中等強度運動、健身和休閒性身體活動，如快步走（騎腳踏車、游泳、排球），而且每次至少持續10分鐘以上的嗎？
fields.description_en: Do you do moderate-intensity sports, fitness, or recreational physical activities that slightly increase your breathing and heart rate, such as brisk walking (cycling, swimming, volleyball), for at least 10 minutes at a time?

fields.description_zh: 請問，您每週通常有多少天進行中等強度運動、健身和休閒性身體活動？
fields.description_en: How many days per week do you usually do moderate-intensity sports, fitness, or recreational physical activities?

fields.description_zh: 請問，有做這些活動的日子，您每天通常花多長時間做這些中等強度的活動？___小時___分鐘 ? 小時
fields.description_en: On days when you do these activities, how much time do you usually spend on these moderate-intensity activities each day? ___ hours ___ minutes ? Hours

fields.description_zh: 請問，有做這些活動的日子，您每天通常花多長時間做這些中等強度的活動？___小時___分鐘 ? 分鐘
fields.description_en: On days when you do these activities, how much time do you usually spend on these moderate-intensity activities each day? ___ hours ___ minutes ? Minutes

fields.description_zh: 一般來說，請問您平均一天坐著的時間，大約有多少小時？包括：聊天、打瞌睡、上班、上學、坐車、看書、看報紙、看電視、玩電腦？共___小時___分鐘 ? 小時
fields.description_en: Generally speaking, on average how many hours a day do you spend sitting? This includes: chatting, dozing off, working, attending school, riding in a vehicle, reading books, reading newspapers, watching TV, using the computer. Total ___ hours ___ minutes? Hours

fields.description_zh: 一般來說，請問您平均一天坐著的時間，大約有多少小時？包括：聊天、打瞌睡、上班、上學、坐車、看書、看報紙、看電視、玩電腦？共___小時___分鐘 ? 分鐘
fields.description_en: Generally speaking, on average how many hours a day do you spend sitting? This includes: chatting, dozing off, working, attending school, riding in a vehicle, reading books, reading newspapers, watching TV, using the computer. Total ___ hours ___ minutes? Minutes

fields.description_zh: 您過去一年內，有沒有出現咳嗽而且發燒的症狀？
fields.description_en: In the past year, did you experience cough and fever symptoms?

fields.description_zh: 您過去一年內，出現咳嗽而且發燒症狀時，在家會不會戴口罩？
fields.value_labels: 1:從來不會, 2:很少會, 3:有時會, 4:總是會
fields.description_en: In the past year, when you had a cough and fever, did you wear a mask at home?

fields.description_zh: 您過去一年內，出現咳嗽而且發燒症狀時，外出會不會戴口罩？
fields.value_labels: 1:從來不會, 2:很少會, 3:有時會, 4:總是會, 5:不外出
fields.description_en: In the past year, when you had a cough and fever, did you wear a mask when going out?

fields.description_zh: 您過去一年內，出現咳嗽而且發燒症狀時，除了看醫生外，您會去上班/上課或出門嗎?
fields.value_labels: 1:從來不會, 2:很少會, 3:有時會, 4:總是會
fields.description_en: In the past year, when you had a cough and fever, besides seeing a doctor, did you still go to work/school or go out?

fields.description_zh: 您在自己(或餵小孩)吃東西前會不會洗手?
fields.value_labels: 0:從來不會, 1:偶爾會, 2:經常會, 3:每一次都會
fields.description_en: Do you wash your hands before eating (or feeding your child)?

fields.description_zh: 您在自己便後(或處理小孩排泄物後)會不會洗手?
fields.value_labels: 0:從來不會, 1:偶爾會, 2:經常會, 3:每一次都會
fields.description_en: Do you wash your hands after using the toilet yourself (or after handling your child's waste)?

fields.description_zh: 您洗手時，會不會按照正確洗手五步驟「濕、搓、沖、捧、擦」來洗手?
fields.value_labels: 0:從來不會, 1:偶爾會, 2:經常會, 3:每一次都會
fields.description_en: When washing your hands, do you follow the correct five-step method ("wet, rub, rinse, cup, dry")?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，您平常有沒有幫忙打掃家裡？
fields.description_en: In the past year, have you usually helped with cleaning the house?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您多久和您的子女見一次面？(以所有子女整體來算，以最經常見面的那位頻率為準)
fields.value_labels: 1:從不見面, 2:每天見面, 3:每週至少2~3次, 4:每週至少1次, 5:每月至少1次, 6:很少見面, 7:沒有子女, 8:子女已過世
fields.description_en: In the past year, how often do you see your children? (Considering all children together, based on the frequency of the child you see most often)

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您多久和您的兄弟姊妹見一次面？
fields.value_labels: 1:從不見面, 2:每天見面, 3:每週至少2~3次, 4:每週至少1次, 5:每月至少1次, 6:很少見面, 7:沒有兄弟姊妹, 8:兄弟姐妹已過世
fields.description_en: In the past year, how often do you see your siblings?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您多久和您的其他親戚見一次面？
fields.value_labels: 1:從不見面, 2:每天見面, 3:每週至少2~3次, 4:每週至少1次, 5:每月至少1次, 6:很少見面, 7:沒有其他親戚, 8:其他親戚已過世
fields.description_en: In the past year, how often do you see your other relatives?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您與朋友多久會聯絡(包括見面、通電話、互相寫信或網路通訊軟體)一次？
fields.value_labels: 1:從不聯絡, 2:每天聯絡, 3:每週至少2~3次, 4:每週至少1次, 5:每月至少1次, 6:很少聯絡, 7:沒有朋友
fields.description_en: In the past year, how often do you contact friends (including meeting in person, phone calls, letters, or internet messaging apps)?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您和鄰居多久會一起聊天、或您到他家或他到您家坐坐(要彼此有聊天、互動才算，只是碰面點頭打招呼不算)？
fields.value_labels: 1:從不來往, 2:每天, 3:每週至少2~3次, 4:每週至少1次, 5:每月至少1次, 6:很少, 7:沒有鄰居
fields.description_en: In the past year, how often do you chat with your neighbors, or visit each other's homes (only counts if there is mutual conversation/interaction, not just nodding hello when passing by)?

fields.description_zh: 您目前有沒有在幫忙照顧自己或別人的小孩（包括子女、孫子女）？
fields.value_labels: 1:沒有, 2:很少（每週不到1次）, 3:有時（每週1~2次）, 4:常常（每天或每週數天）
fields.description_en: Are you currently helping care for your own or someone else's children (including children and grandchildren)?

fields.description_zh: 您目前有沒有在幫忙照顧沒有辦法自行處理生活起居的家人、親戚或朋友?
fields.value_labels: 1:沒有, 2:很少（每週不到1次）, 3:有時（每週1~2次）, 4:常常（每天或每週數天）
fields.description_en: Are you currently helping care for a family member, relative, or friend who cannot manage daily living independently?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，您有沒有擔任義工或志工（不支薪）？
fields.description_en: In the past year, have you served as an (unpaid) volunteer?

fields.description_zh: 您參加的志工是屬於以下哪一類？若有，是多久去參加一次？
fields.description_en: Which of the following categories does your volunteer work belong to? If applicable, how often do you participate?

fields.description_zh: 職業團體（如農會、漁會、工會，以及其他工商行業團體等公會），或政黨團體的志工
fields.value_labels: 0:沒有, 1:每週1次, 2:每月1次, 3:每月不到1次
fields.description_en: Volunteer for occupational groups (such as farmers' associations, fishermen's associations, labor unions, and other business/industry associations) or political party groups

fields.description_zh: 社會團體/其他機關的志工
fields.value_labels: 0:沒有, 1:每週1次, 2:每月1次, 3:每月不到1次
fields.description_en: Volunteer for social groups/other organizations

fields.description_zh: 個人自發性的志工
fields.value_labels: 0:沒有, 1:每週1次, 2:每月1次, 3:每月不到1次
fields.description_en: Individual, self-initiated volunteer work

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，您有沒有參加以下社會團體的會議或活動？
fields.description_en: In the past year, have you attended meetings or activities of the following social groups?

fields.description_zh: 參加職業團體（如農會、漁會、工會，以及其他工商行業團體等公會）、政黨團體或政治性團體（如公民團體等）舉辦的會議
fields.description_en: Attending meetings held by occupational groups (such as farmers' associations, fishermen's associations, labor unions, and other industry/commerce associations, etc.), political party organizations, or political groups (such as civic groups, etc.)

fields.description_zh: 抗議或示威
fields.description_en: Protest or demonstration

fields.description_zh: 簽署請願書，包括電子郵件或網路請願書
fields.description_en: Signed a petition, including email or online petitions

fields.description_zh: 接觸政治人物或公務人員（不包含一般日常洽公）
fields.description_en: Contacted a political figure or public official (not including routine official business)

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您有沒有參加任何宗教活動（例如：進香團、參加教會活動、做禮拜等）？
fields.value_labels: 0:沒有, 1:有，偶爾參加, 2:有，定期參加
fields.description_en: In the past year, have you participated in any religious activities (e.g., pilgrimage groups, church activities, worship services, etc.)?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您有沒有參加社區或鄰里舉辦的團體或活動，如老人會、村里民活動、康樂活動（如早覺會、土風舞、氣功社等）？
fields.value_labels: 0:沒有, 1:有，偶爾參加, 2:有，定期參加
fields.description_en: In the past year, have you participated in any community or neighborhood organized groups or activities, such as senior citizens' associations, village/neighborhood activities, or recreational activities (e.g., morning exercise groups, folk dancing, qigong clubs, etc.)?

fields.description_zh: 請問在過去一個月內，您有沒有參加任何學習活動，例如：去上課、樂齡學習、老人大學、研討會、網路上的課程等？
fields.description_en: In the past month, have you participated in any learning activities, such as: taking classes, active-aging learning programs, senior citizen university, seminars, online courses, etc.?

fields.description_zh: 在過去一年內，請問您是否有在用網路（台語凵ㄥ ㄇㄤ ㄌㄡ），不論是使用電腦、平板電腦或智慧型手機？
fields.description_en: In the past year, have you used the internet (Taiwanese pronunciation), whether using a computer, tablet, or smartphone?

fields.description_zh: 過去三個月，您平均使用網路大約多久一次？
fields.value_labels: 0:沒使用, 1:每月少於1次, 2:每月至少1次, 3:每週至少1次, 4:每天或幾乎每天
fields.description_en: In the past three months, on average, how often did you use the internet?

fields.description_zh: ★在過去一年內，您覺得在您住家社區（鄰里）附近，是否安全？（例如：在天黑了之後，一個人走在住家附近是很安全、安全、不安全、很不安全？） 【本題限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.value_labels: 1:很安全, 2:安全, 3:不安全, 4:很不安全, 5:晚上不出門
fields.description_en: ★Over the past year, do you feel safe in your neighborhood (community)? (For example, is it very safe, safe, unsafe, or very unsafe to walk alone near your home after dark?) [This question must be answered by the respondent themselves; if not the respondent, please select the special code.]

fields.description_en: 【Interviewer verification】Next is Section E; this section must be answered by the sample case themselves, please confirm whether the respondent is the sample case themselves

fields.description_zh: ★行動(今天)
fields.value_labels: 1:我四處走動沒有困難, 2:我四處走動有一點困難, 3:我四處走動有中度的困難, 4:我四處走動有嚴重的困難, 5:我無法四處走動
fields.description_en: ★Mobility (today)

fields.description_zh: ★自我照顧(今天)
fields.value_labels: 1:我自己洗澡或穿衣沒有困難, 2:我自己洗澡或穿衣有一點困難, 3:我自己洗澡或穿衣有中度的困難, 4:我自己洗澡或穿衣有嚴重的困難, 5:我無法自己洗澡或穿衣
fields.description_en: ★Self-care (today)

fields.description_zh: ★平常活動（如工作、讀書、家事、家庭或休閒活動）（今天）
fields.value_labels: 1:我進行日常活動沒有困難, 2:我進行日常活動有一點困難, 3:我進行日常活動有中度的困難, 4:我進行日常活動有嚴重的困難, 5:我無法進行日常活動
fields.description_en: ★Usual activities (such as work, study, housework, family, or leisure activities) (today)

fields.description_zh: ★疼痛/不舒服（今天）
fields.value_labels: 1:我沒有疼痛或不舒服, 2:我有一點疼痛或不舒服, 3:我有中度的疼痛或不舒服, 4:我有嚴重的疼痛或不舒服, 5:我有非常嚴重的疼痛或不舒服
fields.description_en: ★Pain/discomfort (today)

fields.description_zh: ★焦慮/沮喪（今天）
fields.value_labels: 1:我沒有焦慮或沮喪, 2:我有一點焦慮或沮喪, 3:我有中度的焦慮或沮喪, 4:我有嚴重的焦慮或沮喪, 5:我有非常嚴重的焦慮或沮喪
fields.description_en: ★Anxiety/depression (today)

fields.description_zh: ★健康狀態為了幫助一般人陳述健康狀況的好壞，我們畫了一個刻度尺（有點像溫度計），在這刻度尺上，100代表您想像中最好的狀況，0代表您想像中最差的狀況。 我們希望就您的看法，在這個刻度尺上標出您今天健康狀況的好壞。請從下面方格中畫出一條線 ,連到刻度尺上最能代表您今天健康狀況好壞的那一點。 【請出示圖卡中的健康狀況尺規，讓受訪者點出最能代表他今天健康狀況的那一點，再由訪員填寫分數】
fields.description_en: ★Health status: To help people describe how good or bad their health status is, we have drawn a scale (somewhat like a thermometer), where 100 represents the best state you can imagine and 0 represents the worst state you can imagine. We would like you to mark, on this scale, how good or bad your health is today, according to your own view. Please draw a line from the box below to the point on the scale that best represents how good or bad your health is today. [Please show the respondent the health status scale card and have them point to the point that best represents their health today; the interviewer then records the score.]

fields.description_zh: ★接下來，我要請教您過去兩週裡，您的身心健康狀況。
fields.description_en: ★Next, I would like to ask about your physical and mental health condition over the past two weeks.

fields.description_zh: ★您覺得快樂，心情舒暢 （您敢有感覺快樂？心情爽快）
fields.value_labels: 0:完全沒有, 1:偶爾, 2:少於一半時間, 3:一半以上時間, 4:大部分時間, 5:所有時間
fields.description_en: ★You feel happy, in good spirits (Do you feel happy? Do you feel cheerful?)

fields.description_zh: ★您覺得平靜、輕鬆
fields.value_labels: 0:完全沒有, 1:偶爾, 2:少於一半時間, 3:一半以上時間, 4:大部分時間, 5:所有時間
fields.description_en: ★You feel calm and relaxed

fields.description_zh: ★您覺得充滿活力、精力充沛 （您敢有感覺充滿活力？精神真好）
fields.value_labels: 0:完全沒有, 1:偶爾, 2:少於一半時間, 3:一半以上時間, 4:大部分時間, 5:所有時間
fields.description_en: ★You feel full of energy and vigor (Do you feel full of energy? Do you feel great?)

fields.description_zh: ★您睡醒時感到神清氣爽，覺得休息足夠 （您睏醒的時，敢有感覺精神清爽？感覺歇睏了有夠。）
fields.value_labels: 0:完全沒有, 1:偶爾, 2:少於一半時間, 3:一半以上時間, 4:大部分時間, 5:所有時間
fields.description_en: ★You feel refreshed and well-rested when you wake up (When you wake up, do you feel refreshed? Do you feel you've rested enough?)

fields.description_zh: ★您每天生活充滿了有趣的事情
fields.value_labels: 0:完全沒有, 1:偶爾, 2:少於一半時間, 3:一半以上時間, 4:大部分時間, 5:所有時間
fields.description_en: ★Your daily life is full of interesting things

fields.description_en: 【Interviewer verification】This section must be answered by the sample case themselves, please confirm whether the respondent is the sample case themselves ?

fields.description_zh: ★失智症是正常老化的現象?【若受訪者確實不知道什麼是失智症，請點選特殊碼9995】
fields.value_labels: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:不同意, 4:非常不同意, 5:不知道,
fields.description_en: ★Is dementia a normal part of aging? [If the respondent genuinely does not know what dementia is, please select special code 9995.]

fields.description_zh: ★我們無法做任何事情來預防失智症?
fields.value_labels: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:不同意, 4:非常不同意, 5:不知道
fields.description_en: ★There is nothing we can do to prevent dementia?

fields.description_zh: ★失智者的行為是衝動且無法預測的?

fields.description_en: ★Is the behavior of people with dementia impulsive and unpredictable?

fields.description_zh: ★失智者大多時候具有危險性?

fields.description_en: ★Are people with dementia dangerous most of the time?

fields.description_zh: ★如果家人罹患失智症，最好送他/她到照護機構，即使他/她並不願意?

fields.description_en: ★If a family member has dementia, is it best to send him/her to a care facility, even if he/she is unwilling?

fields.description_zh: ★為了不要給予失智者壓力，移除失智者的家庭責任是重要的?
fields.value_labels: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:不同意, 4:非常不同意, 5:不知道
fields.description_en: ★In order to avoid putting pressure on a person with dementia, is it important to remove their family responsibilities?

fields.description_zh: ★您會擔心您有一天會患有失智症?
fields.value_labels: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:不同意, 4:非常不同意, 5:不知道
fields.description_en: ★Are you worried that you might develop dementia someday?

fields.description_zh: ★如果您罹患失智症，您會盡量不告知別人您是失智症者?
